notes: Source and Source 2: a Source install keeps its engine in bin/engine.dll (bin/engine.so on Linux) beside the shared platform/ folder (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Source_SDK_Base, https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Gameinfo.txt); Source 2 moved it to game/bin/win64/engine2.dll (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Source_2). Both halves are required for Source 1 so a stray Engine.dll from an unrelated runtime is not read as Valve's. Native PC path only; not an enginehost family.
